description: Deploy a Processor (managed lane) from a manifest and ES module code. Deploying is free; each run holds a small amount of your Cloud credits. Needs a key with the "spend" permission. max_usd caps what one run may hold.

code.description: ES module source for the managed lane

computeApiKey.description: Singularity Cloud API key with the "spend" permission (cloud.x402compute.cc > Settings > API keys).

idempotency_key.description: A new unique id per purchase (8 to 128 letters, digits, . _ : -). Repeating a purchase with the SAME id never charges twice.

manifest.description: Processor manifest (slug, name, description, lane "managed", price_usd, limits, payout)

max_usd.description: The most one run may hold from your credits, in US dollars

name: cloud_deploy_processor
